content: I see t1 assigned to me but agent_teams_claim_task rejects member claims ('members cannot set assignee'). I'll proceed with UI audit; please advise/claim if task capability needed.

Found UI issue in app/src/main/java/com/maodouchat/ui/screen/settings/SettingsSubScreens.kt: ThemeRow (3214) and LanguageRow (3336) use non-scrollable chip Rows, unlike wallpaper/bubble rows; 4 theme chips clip on narrow screens, making scheduled inaccessible. Suggested modifier fillMaxWidth().horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()) on both. Edit tool blocked because session already danger-full-access rejects escalation; captain may apply.

Second concrete share-flow bug: ContactSubScreens.kt QR sharing launches context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(...)) inside withContext(Dispatchers.IO) (lines 287-305). Activity launch should happen on Main; keep file/URI creation IO, return intent/URI, then launch chooser on caller coroutine Main. Background launch can fail on Android thread/Looper and shows generic shareFailed.

QA mapping findings so far: repo root is Android Compose Gradle project; server is independent Ktor Gradle project (`server/settings.gradle.kts`), Gradle wrapper 8.14.5, JDK 21 required, compileSdk 36. npm only Playwright scripts: `npm run test:admin-e2e`, `test:website`, `test:developer-e2e`, `preview`. CI gates in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: server compile/test + Postgres tagged integration + 3 browser E2Es; Android compileDebugKotlin/unit tests/lint/assembleDebug/release+verifyReleaseSize + aapt2; compose config/topology/Caddy validation + bash -n. Release builds signed/unsigned fallback APK, server installDist, selfhost tar, checksums. Git refs read-only: local main=f01bac1e, origin/main=b486b694; reflog shows local ahead by 4 commits (latest robot CSV + GROUP_PLAY_UPDATE), so do not pull/reset; preserve local commits and push/merge intentionally. `reference/` is explicitly gitignored local design/source material (Ideaura, Murexide, Telegram, blind_watermark), README says delete when done. No deployment config or Hong Kong host in repo; deploy scripts expect SSH/operator on target and `.env` secrets.

Deployment checklist/risks: preflight target with `bash scripts/deploy.sh --doctor`; verify DNS A/AAAA, ports 80/443 TCP+UDP, TURN 3478 TCP/UDP + 49160-49200 UDP, Docker daemon/Compose v2, JDK not needed on target if building Docker. Ensure `.env` strong distinct JWT/PG/PUSH/TURN secrets, HTTPS BASE_URL exactly PUBLIC_HOST, SMTP/TURN or `--relaxed`, ADMIN_PATH, MASTER_ADMINS/bootstrap, CORS. Before update: `backup-production.sh --dry-run`, then full backup; `update.sh` defaults backup + ff-only pull + offline topology + rebuild, but local branch currently ahead origin so avoid remote pull until commits pushed/remote reconciled. After deploy: `/health/live`, `/health/ready`, `scripts/status.sh --health-check`, compose no unhealthy, admin hidden route + login, registration, WS, E2E smoke, attachments/E2EE/group sender keys/calls, verify backups. Risks: release workflow emits installable temporary debug-signed APK if keystore secret absent; `backup-production.sh --dry-run` creates `backups/` and `.partial-*` (despite docs saying no writes); release/selfhost artifact needs JDK/Gradle and artifact URL wiring; reference assets are untracked/ignored and must not enter commit.

Audit finding: concrete backend management defect in RuntimeConfigService.setMany + AdminRouting PUT /api/admin/settings. setMany silently filters unknown keys (lines 866-881), while route always records ADMIN_SETTINGS_UPDATE and responds status ok (AdminRouting 1572-1593), so typos/stale controls report success but have no effect. Proposed fix: add `fun unknownKeys(values: Map<String,String>): Set<String> = values.keys.filterNot { it in knownKeys }.toSet()`; in route after updates empty check, reject unknown with 400 before setMany/audit; in setMany fail closed if unknownKeys nonempty (return all unchanged). Add unit test asserting unknown key detection. File edits blocked by tool sandbox mode reporting current danger-full-access cannot escalate; captain should apply patch. No overlap with UI/crypto.

Follow-up requested details: exact changed paths: none (audit-only; no files modified). Test commands/results: none run; no test added because write tools were blocked by the session's permission-mode error. Identified affected paths (not changed): `server/src/main/kotlin/com/maodouchat/server/service/RuntimeConfigService.kt` lines 866-881 (`setMany` filters unknown keys) and `server/src/main/kotlin/com/maodouchat/server/plugins/AdminRouting.kt` lines 1572-1593 (always responds/audits success). Recommended verification: `cd server && ../gradlew test --tests '*RuntimeConfig*'` plus focused admin settings route test. Overlap risk: none with UI or crypto files; only backend management settings contract.

Found concrete crypto defect in app/src/main/java/com/maodouchat/crypto/SignalProtocol.kt: processSenderKeyDistributionEnvelope wraps GroupSessionBuilder.process in runCatching and classifies DuplicateMessageException as Failed. At-least-once SKDM replay then blocks sync cursor/retries forever. Patch process call with try/catch DuplicateMessageException => SenderKeyDistOutcome.Installed. Also sound gaps in AppNotifier: showMessageReminder (line 247), showTestNotification (508), showAiTaskReminder (681) use hardcoded/non-runtime preference; gate with NotificationSoundPolicy.messageSoundEnabled(runtimeFlag NOTIFICATION_SOUND, user pref). Tool sandbox currently rejects edits because current mode is already danger-full-access; please apply these patches if needed.

Intended patch remains adding RuntimeConfigService.unknownKeys and rejecting unknown settings in AdminRouting before setMany/audit; no commit/deploy.
